# theme-viewmodel spec

**Feature**: Scriptlog "blog" theme - PostViewModel rendering parity on single posts and
shared cards
**Generated by**: Playwright Planner Agent (per `prompts/11-master-playwright-planner.md`)
**App**: Scriptlog, PHP >= 7.4, MVC, Bootstrap 4, jQuery
**Bootstrap**: use `e2e/seed.spec.ts` and `playwright.config.js`
**Phase**: Plan section 5.2 Phase 2 - "ViewModels"

---

## Purpose

Verify that the single post view and the shared card partial (`partials/card.php`) render
the same normalized fields (title, date, author, content/excerpt, topics, media) from the
`PostViewModel`, and that `prepare_post_card()` never fatals on missing data. This locks the
ViewModel normalization boundary so no field regresses to a raw array echo.

---

## URLs

| Route | Expected |
|-------|----------|
| `/` | 200, `.latest-posts` grid of `.post` cards |
| `/blog` | 200, `.post` cards via same partial |
| `/?p=11` | 200, `.post-single` with title/date/author/content |
| `/?cat=200` | 200, `.post` cards (topic listing) |
| `/?tag=e2e-tag` | 200, `.post` cards |
| `/?a=202608` | 200, `.post` cards (monthly archive) |

---

## Preconditions

- `blogware_e2e` seeded: post ID 11 published with title "Test Numeric Post" and non-null
  `post_summary`; post ID 12 protected; topic 200 mapped to >= 3 published posts; tag
  `e2e-tag` on posts 11 and 12; posts in August 2026 for the archive route.
- Active theme `blog`; rewrite disabled (query-string URLs).

---

## User Actions

- Load home and assert the latest-posts grid contains the shared card markup.
- Open a post card and confirm the single page renders the same title and date.
- Load category, tag, and archive listing and confirm cards share the same DOM shape
  (same `h3.h4` title, same meta partial).

---

## Expected Behaviour

- Every `.post` card contains exactly one `h3.h4` link, one `.post-meta` with date + topics,
  and the `partials/meta.php` author/date/comments block.
- No card renders "Array" or a fatal error when a post lacks media (placeholder image used).
- Single post title on `/` equals title on `/?p=ID` for the same post.

---

## Validation Rules

- `locator('.latest-posts .post h3.h4 a')` count equals the number of `.post` cards.
- On `/blog`, `locator('.posts-listing .post')` count >= 1 and every card has `h3.h4`.
- Card title text on home for post X matches `page.locator('.post-single h1')` text on
  `/?p=X`.

---

## UI Components

- `partials/card.php`: `.post`, `.post-thumbnail`, `.post-details`, `h3.h4`, `.post-meta`,
  `partials/meta.php`.
- `single.php`: `.post-single`, `h1`, `.post-details`, `.post-body`, `.post-tags`,
  `.posts-nav`.

---

## Accessibility

- Card titles are links with matching `title` attribute.
- Images have `alt` (caption) or empty alt for placeholders.

---

## Console

- No PHP warnings visible in output (assert no "Warning"/"Fatal" text on any page).

---

## Test Scenarios (prioritized)

Critical:
- Home latest-posts cards render with the shared `h3.h4` + meta structure.
- Single post renders title/date/author/content without "Array".
- Card title on a listing equals single post title.

High:
- Category, tag, and archive listings render cards with identical structure.
- Card without media falls back to placeholder (no fatal).

Regression:
- Same assertions pass after any ViewModel/partial refactor.

---

## Notes for the Generator Agent

Generate `e2e/theme-viewmodel.spec.js`. Use stable class selectors (`h3.h4`, `.post-single`,
`.post-meta`). For title parity, capture the card link text for the newest post on `/blog`
then compare to the single page. Run chromium/firefox/webkit.
